submitted.rationale: EQE rose steadily with Sb fraction: 0.0086% at Sb 0.32, 0.016% at 0.52, 0.025% at 0.68 and a peak of 0.034% at 0.81. It then fell to 0.022% at 0.85. So the maximum is near Sb≈0.8, in the Sb-rich rutile-type CrSbO4 alloy region.

rejected.reason: EQE dropped to 0.022% at Sb 0.85, past the optimum
